Under the general supervision of the Manager, Telecom Engineers and Field Technicians, the Telecommunications Administrator applies skills as a seasoned, experienced communications professional with a full understanding of industry practices and relevant policies and procedures and solid telecommunications knowledge and experience to support, administer, maintain, and enhance UC Irvine’s enterprise communications services. Provides telephone, voicemail, ACD/call center, automated attendant, and 911 services to UCI Irvine faculty, staff, and students, while resolving a wide range of complex technical issues and independently determining appropriate solutions. Demonstrates competency in selecting methods and techniques to obtain solutions. Processes telecommunications service requests; performs client-side system administration, maintenance, and support for the campus Mitel PBX, Microsoft Teams Phone, AWS Connect contact center platform, analog gateway infrastructure, and related telecommunications systems; and supports VOIP, digital, softphone, and analog technologies. The primary focus of the position is driving Teams Phone migrations and supporting enterprise telecommunications modernization initiatives. The successful candidate will possess strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, experience improving operational processes and workflows, and the ability to provide technical leadership, project support, design consultation, and vendor coordination. The position is also responsible for maintaining technical documentation, inventory records, and accurate telecommunications billing.
Able to learn effectively and meet deadlines.
Participates in an on-call rotation to respond to incidents outside of normal business hours.
Self-motivated and works independently and as part of a team.
Adhere to OIT’s cultural values: Collaboration, Respect, Trust, Transparency, Quality, Inclusiveness, Customer Centricity, and Learning and Growth.

Demonstrated thorough knowledge of professional telecommunications and network concepts necessary to resolve issues using established parameters, creativity and independent judgment, escalating as necessary.

Thorough understanding of various telecommunication and network hardware platforms, network related protocols and software including understanding of OSI layer 3 protocols at a basic level and layer 2 protocols at a complex level and related technical standards critical to the operation of interconnected networks.
Ability to gather, organize and analyze data in the completion of a variety of functional assignments, recommend solutions, and prepare computer generated reports.
Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information to technical and non-technical personnel at various levels in the organization.
Demonstrated diverse problem-solving skills and follows change management policies and procedures.
Demonstrate project management skills in meeting deadlines, provide status updates, and assess risk.

Maintains a positive attitude while achieving departmental goals. Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, conflict resolution, and customer service skills while working with internal and external customers/vendors.
Proven skills working with computer systems including proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and other common applications.
Proficient in Agentic AI tools such as Claude, Chatgpt, Google Gemini, and Microsoft Copilot to analyze data, improve processes, and troubleshoot complex problems.
